hops.note: Added as clientIp, returning the first x-forwarded-for address or the socket address.
Renamed to apiKey and now returns the x-api-key header or a bearer token, or "anonymous".
Formatting-only: single quotes became double quotes.
Added the token bucket step, which refills by elapsed time up to capacity, rejects below one token with a retryAfterMs, and otherwise spends one token.
The windowMs parameter was renamed refillWindowMs, with the math unchanged.
Added a fixed-window middleware that counts each client IP per window in a module Map and answers 429 when the window is full.
Became async, reads and writes counts through a pluggable store, takes a key function, and answers 429 if the store throws.
The default key function became apiKey instead of clientIp.
Replaced the fixed window with take() on a stored token bucket per key.
A store error now calls next() and lets the request through instead of answering 429.
Reverted to answering 429 when the store throws.
Sets RateLimit and Retry-After headers on every response and records each decision in optional metrics.
Reads refillWindowMs instead of windowMs, passes options.limit * 2 as the bucket capacity, and drops RateLimit-Reset from allowed responses.
Added to build the RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, and RateLimit-Reset headers, plus Retry-After when the caller must wait.
Formatting-only: single quotes became double quotes.
Added an in-memory count of allowed and rejected requests with record() and snapshot().
Formatting-only: its two object literals were split across lines.
Added in src/window.ts to allow a request while count <= limit and return the new count and remaining.
Changed count <= limit to count < limit so a window allows exactly limit requests.
Deleted with src/window.ts when the token bucket replaced the fixed window.
Created in src/store.ts from the in-memory counts Map that createLimiter read and wrote, now behind a CounterStore read and write interface.
Stores and returns copies of a BucketState of tokens and updatedAt, and returns undefined for an unknown key.
Added as the windowMs option of createLimiter, used to compute the fixed window id.
The statement that reads windowMs moved inside the new try block and keys on keyFn(req), with the window math unchanged.
windowMs is now passed to take() as the time the bucket takes to refill instead of a window length.
Renamed to refillWindowMs in Options and in the take() call.
Added as the number of requests allowed per window, passed to hitWindow().
hitWindow() now compares limit with a count read from the store.
limit is now the token bucket capacity passed to take().
limit is also sent to callers as the RateLimit-Limit header.
The bucket capacity became options.limit * 2 while the RateLimit-Limit header still reports limit.
Set to 0.0.0 in the first package.json.
Bumped from 0.0.0 to 0.1.0.
Bumped from 0.1.0 to 0.3.0.
Bumped from 0.3.0 to 0.9.0.
Bumped from 0.9.0 to 1.0.0.
Added createRedisStore, which keeps each counter in Redis under a wayfinder: key prefix.
Stores each bucket state as JSON instead of a plain counter.
Deleted with the Redis adapter, so buckets live only in process memory.
Added owners for src/bucket.ts, src/store.ts, and src/redis.ts.
Dropped the src/redis.ts line.
